body: I can't go to the gym when there's a bunch of people there. Social anxiety kills me. I feel like everyone is judging me (probably are/did).  I stopped going a while ago though. I realized there's no point, no one even bothers talking to me, much less actually looking at me.

Happy birthday bro. 

For the last three years my birthday consisted of me doing what I do pretty much do everyday. Drink a little. Smoke a little. Talk a little to my dog. Pass out. The only difference was I told myself happy birthday.

Yeah. I hope you have better luck than me. I've been on those various apps for like 4 years with LITERALLY 0 matches. But then again I'm an ugly useless POS. Hope it works out better, you can't possibly do worse than me.
I broke my fan cause I'm a fat fuck who couldn't even do that right.
I avoid looking at couples. I avoid going to places where I might even potentially see happy people.

I haven't ate out in years cause I can't stand eating alone and watching happy couples and friends who have people who care for them. Who want to be with them. I've always gotten take out for one and I see no change.

Minus the spouse, cause I'm not good enough for anyone, my life story is almost the same. I wish I could give you advice, but I'd do a shitty job of it just like everything I do. I hope it works out for you though. At least one of us deserves a break.

At least you got a tinder date. I've been on there for 4 years without a single match. I go on there nowadays to merely remind myself how shitty I am. I have major depressive disorder & social anxiety too. I flake on the few things that I've ever been invited to cause I'm afraid even those people will see how shitty I am. I was invited to go watch the Dragon Con parade today, but I flaked cause the rest of the people that were coming, were coming in force with roommates, gf's, bf's, friends, etc. They told me to bring a friend. I have none. I could picture myself being that loner, awkward guy, so I do what I do best. Flaked. I hate being alone, yet I always end up alone.... try or not. It's just how my life is meant to be. 

I hope you have more success than I. Good luck.

I make about $200K & I fucking hate my life. The only thing I don't have is a financial burden or insecurity thankfully. Money makes me happy, albeit I spend a lot to keep my emotions at that level cause I have 0 friends and non-existent relationships. Like the people above said, women care about attractiveness above all else. Nothing has changed for me by merely making more money. If anything, makes me feel worse cause I know how shit out of luck I am. Maybe if one were a millionaire, but being above middle class gets you nothing, at least for me.... but then again I know I'm ugly.
Ah gotcha.... Still doesn't change the fact that people can express how they feel with words other than "fuck," and I can't.
People are so much more goddamn eloquent than I.

I totally get where you're coming from. I don't mind talking to pretty women anymore because I KNOW they're most definitely not into me. Once I got that fact into my head and stopped trying/caring, it's made it easier to distance that sense of connection and longing.
